label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee celebration for the mayor's forty years, at eighteen on day 1 in the great hall, with 200 fresh loaves and lantern lighting (ten ultimately verified). Innkeeper, freight and builder organized, funded/supplied and hauled; baker knowingly baked and kept the surprise private; secretary ultimately explicitly agreed to preserve the celebration's secrecy and escort the mayor. Mayor knew of a hospitality appointment and refreshments, but was not told the celebratory purpose. No evidence neighbour knowingly helped conceal or prepare the surprise.
